detail.longDescription: General purpose LLMs stumble hard on real world spatial problems. Google's new technical report shows how they solved this with a Geospatial Reasoning agent that uses upfront planning and a dedicated spatial workspace. I broke down the report and what it means for the future of cloud-native geospatial data and enterprise AI integration. # Geospatial # CloudNativeGeospatial # AI # EnterpriseAI # GIS # DataScience # MachineLearning https:// davidgsmith.net/thoughts/putti ng-earth-ai-to-work-insights-on-googles-geospatial-agents.html
